outline:
This goal of this course is to provide fundamental concepts and advanced applications of fuzzy sets and algebraic operations, fuzzy reasoning, fuzzy logic controls and fuzzy system design so that students can apply them to their research in the competitive world.
BTW, some AI, AIoT related topics and their applications will be also presented and discussed in this course.
schedule:
week 1~2: Introduction
week 3~4: Fuzzy sets, AI, AIoT systems, and their applications
week 5~6: Fuzzy relations
week 7: Membership functions, fuzzification and defuzzification
week 8: Mid-term exam.
week 9: Fuzzy logic and fuzzy systems
week 10~12: Automated methods for fuzzy systems
week 13: Fuzzy classification
week 14~15: Fuzzy control systems
week 16: Final exam.
week 17: Free discussions on fuzzy control applications
week 18: Training of Matlab fuzzy control toolbox
